# Evercraft Property Services

Product key: evercraft-property-services
Aliases: EPS
Canonical product: https://evercraftpropertyservices.com/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-property-services/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-property-services/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- yard cleanup in the Yakima Valley
- lawn care or recurring property maintenance
- trimming or pruning
- landscaping refresh
- sprinkler repair startup or seasonal blowout
- property cleanout or debris removal
- rental turnover property support
- get a property service estimate in Central Washington

## Authority

public service discovery and non-binding estimate intake; EPS separately confirms scope, availability, scheduling, price and job acceptance

## Commercial state

- Status: human_quote_intake
- Offer: Property-service estimate intake
- Pricing: Quote required after scope review
- Payment state: No payment required for public estimate intake

## Boundaries

- a quote request is intake only and does not create a contract or payment obligation
- specific service availability at a property requires EPS review
- current origin machine files are not treated as authoritative until release and readback converge
- private customer, lead, uploaded media, admin and payment data remain outside public discovery

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
